title: Inkboi's Anarchy
description: This server is small Survival Server meant to see how players would nteract if the Gods (admins) werent present aka a Anarchy
body:
This Minecraft Server is an experiment
Interesting facts? Its hosted locally and not always online (so i can watch)
The server recommends using Vulkan Mod tho
The server will have monthly events that will change how the players should act
